title: Claude-assisted photo description/categorization
description: Add an Edge Function (supabase/functions/) that calls the Claude API when a photo is uploaded, to auto-generate a description and category (renovation/landscaping/paint/appliance/etc). This is the core differentiating feature of Houstory vs a plain photo album.

title: Design core schema (homes, photos, renovation/landscaping projects, paint colors, appliances)
description: Design and write the initial Supabase migration(s) under supabase/migrations/ for Houstory's core data model: homes, photo records (with storage bucket refs), renovation projects, landscaping projects, paint colors, appliances. Mirror five-wonders' migration style (numbered, sequential .sql files).

title: Scaffold Houstory infra to mirror Five Wonders
description: Set up GitHub repo, Supabase project, static site skeleton, and domain wiring for Houstory, following the pattern used in five-wonders (static HTML/CSS/JS + Supabase + GitHub Pages custom domain).
close_reason: Repo, Supabase project, and static-site scaffold created; follow-up feature work filed as separate issues

title: Build initial site pages (add/view home entries, upload photos)
description: Replace the placeholder index.html with real pages mirroring five-wonders' page-per-feature pattern (index, add-item, view, profile, etc), backed by the Supabase schema and Edge Functions once those land.

title: Wire up houstory.app custom domain
description: Once houstory.app is registered, add a CNAME file to the repo root (like five-wonders' CNAME -> fivewonders.app), point DNS at GitHub Pages, and set the custom domain in repo Settings > Pages.
close_reason: Domain purchased as houstory.homes (not .app). CNAME file added and GitHub Pages custom domain set to houstory.homes. DNS records still need to be added at Namecheap.
